protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias; weights and training cutoff not independently verified.
protocol.sample_selection: Fixed random numeracy-proportional subset of the frozen 192-per-month age/income design; no current outcomes used, retain sequential inclusion weights.
protocol.month_selection: Same three windows chosen for the Event probe before source retrieval: pandemic, high inflation and tariff-risk stages. Inspected development windows, not blind holdout.
protocol.comparison: Exact old prompts versus the same prompts plus dated public consumer-context/policy brief; no peer inflation forecast numbers.
protocol.decision_rule: No automatic upgrade. Report center, W1, individual error, stable-case false moves and moving-case missed moves; do not retune text on these results.
protocol.truth_isolation: Preparation hashes but never parses current SCE targets. Sampling uses only frozen P and links.
limits: Three inspected development months, not independent goal confirmation.
Twenty-four people per month is a mechanism screen, not national reconstruction.
Public survey background is not personal measured exposure or beliefs.
Narrative and policy facts are bundled; no separate causal attribution.
True previous answers are A conditions; not recurrent or strict public B.
Two generations are repeated calls, not new people. Mutable model alias remains.
